_about: Animals on Plot 01 (docs/world.md sections 6.5-6.8 and 7). The scene is a June evening, about 20:30, sun low in the west-north-west: 'active' says what each animal is doing at that hour. Routes are [x, z] in metres and are checked against src/world/obstacles.js by test/fauna.test.js, so no animal walks through a tree, rock, the wall or water. Animals not shown now are listed with the reason.

deer.active: dusk feeding; browses an oak sapling in the gap (interaction 1)

fox.active: evening patrol; pounces on voles in the pioneer edge grass

boar.active: sow and striped piglets rooting at the wallow (interaction 10)

badger.active: emerges from the sett around sunset in June, scratches, then forages along its trail towards the gap (interaction 13)

hare.active: feeding along the path at dusk

squirrel.active: last feeding of the day on the gap log

jay.active: on the stump; it caches acorns in Sep-Oct, not in June, so interaction 3 waits for the autumn scenes

woodpecker.active: on the dead beech in the gap, then over to the cone anvil at the plantation edge (interaction 20)

owl.active: still roosting in a holly until dark

robin.active: follows the rooting boar for exposed invertebrates (interaction 11); evening song

wren.active: around its nest in the biggest root plate

nuthatch.active: climbing head-down on the ivy-clad oak by the stream

buzzard.active: soars over the hedge and meadow strip, then perches on the snag by the windthrow to watch for voles (interaction 8)

frog.active: froglets and adults in the damp grass by the backwater

salamander.active: larvae in the backwater (deposited Mar-May); adults come out on rainy nights, so not now

lizard.active: basking on the warm stone on the outcrop in the last sun

slowworm.active: out at dusk at the outcrop foot, hunting slugs (interaction 41)

speckledWood.active: males hold sunflecks at the gap rim

demoiselle.active: flutters between perches over the shaded stream (May-Aug)

ants.active: trails from the mound up the nearest spruce to the aphids (interaction 33)

notShownNow.Bats (Plecotus auritus, Nyctalus noctula: emerge after sunset; with the time-of-day step
notShownNow.Peacock (Aglais io) adults: the overwintered adults are gone by June and the new brood flies from July; the caterpillars are shown on the nettles
